decisions.opus: single control plane and intelligence layer; not a flat shared data plane
decisions.opus_internal: Cyber/Sentinel is an Opus System/Security domain, not a personal LifeContract
decisions.companies: separate tenant per legal/operational business with own agents, UI, connectors and policy
decisions.ui: one canonical login with explicit Personal/System/Company context and separate cockpits

decisions.authority: Morten is top admin/authority-holder; agents steward scopes and do not become owners
